notes.title: v1.0a - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Catalysts--oh, wait, that's my other game.
Hi!! I'm glad all of you have been having fun with Dreams of Aether! It's been a big rush of excitement to actually finish this game and get it out there.

Anyway, here's a small patch that fixes some things!

Patch notes for v1.0a:

[u][h3]DREAM CHANGES:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Reed in the Weeds: added a failsafe to move the exit in case it's blocked.
[*] Missile Don't Miss: the cursor now pulses when firing a shot for extra feedback.
[*] Land Ho!: Switched the oars around so they visually push the boat correctly. Controls haven't changed.
[/list]

[u][h3]MENU BEHAVIOR:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Updated the stage name "Endless Assault" to "Endless Divide". The achievement text was more up to date.
[*] When unlocking the final stage, the music now fades earlier.
[*] Fixed auto-playing map dialogue ending early when viewing a different menu.
[*] Holding left/right on slider settings (volume, stick deadzone) now repeats adjusting it.
[*] Fixed some minor visual issues with the stage menu's best score window.
[/list]

[u][h3]JAPANESE LOCALIZATION:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a missing credits title.
[*] The "Endless/Story/Back" stage menu now scrolls to not overlap with the subtitle.
[/list]

[u][h3]ALSO:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Made the line "Is fashion important?" in hodan's intro appear slightly earlier.
[*] Resetting your save file now resets your controls too.
[*] Fixed the Steam Screenshot function not registering.
[/list]
